name: Adaptive Sampling with Variance-Based Step Size
definition: A technique to control sampling density in unstructured volumes by adjusting the step size based on the normalized variance of a partition, allowing users to tune the trade-off between image quality and frame rate.
summary: Adaptive Sampling with Variance-Based Step Size adjusts ray-marching step size based on precomputed partition variance to balance quality and speed, distinctively using statistical metrics instead of gradients and including opacity correction for consistency.
